description: Query the LOCAL CACHE of every page this server has fetched and every search it has run. Check here BEFORE re-fetching or re-searching — a hit is instant and free while a fresh fetch costs 5-60s. Use query for full-text search (works for Chinese substrings and English words), get to pull a page's full cached content, stats for counts, clear to delete rows.

all.description: With clear: delete everything cached for this caller

clear.description: Delete matching rows instead of returning them (requires url, since_hours, or all)

get.description: Return the FULL cached content of this exact URL instead of listing hits

kind.description: Which rows to search: "auto" (default, pages + searches), "pages", or "searches"

query.description: Full-text search over cached page contents, titles, URLs and past search queries. Omit to list the latest rows.

since_hours.description: Only rows stored within the last N hours

stats.description: Return row counts and database size instead of rows

url.description: Only rows whose URL contains this substring

name: cache
